runtime/api-quickstart.js.title: Runtime API Quickstart
runtime/api-quickstart.js.description: A compact introduction to common OpenDesk Runtime globals and execution context.
runtime/api-quickstart.js.expected: The script prints its quickstart values and exits successfully.

runtime/console.js.title: Console Output
runtime/console.js.description: Print log, info, warning, error, object, group, and timing output without changing the desktop.
runtime/console.js.expected: The child execution exits successfully and prints representative console output.

runtime/global-this.js.title: Global Runtime Object
runtime/global-this.js.description: Inspect globalThis and temporarily attach values and functions within the current execution.
runtime/global-this.js.expected: Temporary global values are created, read, and removed inside the execution.

runtime/promise.js.title: Promises
runtime/promise.js.description: Use await, Promise.all, rejection handling, and Promise.race in OpenDesk JavaScript.
runtime/promise.js.expected: Promise results and the race winner are printed.

runtime/sleep.js.title: Sleep
runtime/sleep.js.description: Pause an execution with sleep() and sleepSeconds().
runtime/sleep.js.expected: The example resumes after bounded waits and completes.

runtime/timer.js.title: Timers
runtime/timer.js.description: Use setTimeout, setInterval, clearTimeout, and clearInterval.
runtime/timer.js.expected: The scheduled callbacks run and the canceled timeout does not run.

runtime/environment.js.title: Environment
runtime/environment.js.description: Read selected execution environment information without dumping the complete process environment.
runtime/environment.js.expected: Selected environment values and execution context are printed.

runtime/path.js.title: Paths and Script Context
runtime/path.js.description: Inspect path helpers together with Execution.scriptPath and Execution.scriptDir.
runtime/path.js.expected: Normalized repository and script-context paths are printed.

runtime/file.js.title: File Operations
runtime/file.js.description: Create, read, copy, move, and validate files inside the example artifact area.
runtime/file.js.expected: The example validates its isolated file operations and exits successfully.

runtime/file-json.js.title: JSON Files
runtime/file-json.js.description: Read and write JSON through the OpenDesk File API using execution-owned async operations.
runtime/file-json.js.expected: JSON data is written, read back, and printed from the execution artifact area.

runtime/command.js.title: Command
runtime/command.js.description: Run the platform's fixed echo command through Command.run() and validate the bounded result.
runtime/command.js.expected: A fixed echo child process succeeds and its bounded output is validated.

runtime/app-storage.js.title: App Storage
runtime/app-storage.js.description: Store text and JSON strings in persistent application storage using execution-scoped example keys.
prerequisites: Writes persistent AppStorage values using a key prefixed with the current Execution.id.
runtime/app-storage.js.expected: Text and JSON values round-trip successfully.

runtime/system-info.js.title: System Information
runtime/system-info.js.description: Inspect local system, process, network, user, and hardware information.
prerequisites: Review output before sharing logs; it can include host- or user-identifying information.
runtime/system-info.js.expected: Detailed local system information is printed.

runtime/system-session-state.js.title: System Session State
runtime/system-session-state.js.description: Read session capability metadata and the current session state when supported.
runtime/system-session-state.js.expected: Capabilities and supported session state are printed.

runtime/page-wait.js.title: Page Wait
runtime/page-wait.js.description: Use fixed waits, condition polling, AbortSignal cancellation, and waitForAll without desktop input.
runtime/page-wait.js.expected: Bounded wait examples complete and cancellation is reported.
